notes: The owner panel is rebuilt as an instrument panel instead of a list of buttons. A status strip at the top carries a live dot, the running build in large type and the rev beside it; Composer and Release sit under small uppercase kickers; Session is a right-aligned key/value column with Copy diagnostics. The note kind is a segmented control rather than a cycler, the character budget is a bar that turns red when you pass it, and the fields use the same focus ring and padding as the shared widgets so the page reads as part of the program instead of a side project. Nothing it can do has changed: the same update check, restart, compose, publish and copy actions, on the same owner-only page.
